questions.q: Which of the following statements is correct about the oxygen $\left(\mathrm{O}_2\right)$ dissociation curves ( $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{C}$ ) relative to curve $\mathbf{B}$ ?

Curve $\mathbf{C}$ represents favourable $\mathrm{O}_2$ association with haemoglobin at high $\mathrm{pO}_2$.
Curve $\mathbf{C}$ represents favourable $\mathrm{O}_2$ association with haemoglobin at low $\mathrm{pCO}_2$.
Curve A represents favourable $\mathrm{O}_2$ association with haemoglobin at low pH .

Curve C represents blood present in left ventricle.
